record_cases.name: production_private_ai_record_context_cancel_pending_export_retains_erasure_custody
record_cases.observed: Exact actual record-bearing add-message received, original acknowledgement deliberately held. Public cancellation records intent before native effect. Independently authorized public HTTP erasure reserves member authority; immediate read admission probes all current member identities and observes authority-busy while erasure is unfinished. Exact original ACK released, erasure completes at revision2 and replay preserves original immutable receipt. No native consultation effect or repeated provider creation/export, owned provider closes once; original remote/primary audio usable both directions. Focused and current six-case cohort pass. This is pending acknowledgement custody, not unfinished socket WRITE backpressure.

record_cases.name: production_private_ai_record_context_requires_actual_listener_original_audience
record_cases.observed: Actual prior Session invitation includes owner and remote, explicitly excludes the later private AI listener identity. Owner actual HTTP ContextView sees the ready Record as Available while retaining context_view/record_get; broad execution authority remains. Actual private add-message excludes every Record reference and the source UUID because the listener lacks its original audience. Other authorized history, actual private duplex and actual original return remain usable. Focused12.92sec and current six-case cohort pass.

record_cases.name: production_private_ai_record_context_listener_share_revocation_stops_original_memory
record_cases.observed: Same real prior source excludes AI. Owner grants an explicit Record-only history share to that actual listener through public named MembershipSnapshot/ShareHistory APIs; committed mutation receipt and current revision are checked. Actual private export contains exact UUID/Session/revision, available canonical vCon and matching unsigned digest; duplex is observed. Revoke that original sharing ID through the public facade under current revision. The same opaque provider instance stops, private audio remains stopped and credentials remain current; no second creation/export occurs. Actual primary return completes. Focused12.72sec and current six-case cohort pass. This is a Record resource grant, not a grant to private captured Connection epochs.
